title: Framing an AI with Values Reduces AI Reliance in AI-supported Writing Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the homogenizing effect of Western-centric AI suggestions by measuring AI reliance (acceptance rate, proportion of AI-generated text) and writing uniqueness (lexical diversity, cosine similarity, thematic analysis) in essays co-written by Indian and American participants.

Classifying AI autocomplete suggestions to determine whether they support, contradict, or remain neutral toward 15 specific value statements derived from the World Values Survey, covering social, trust, security, and religious dimensions.
